description:
Every AI review prompt treats user decisions recorded on the reviewed issue as binding, so a decision the user made is never re-litigated by one review while another honours it.

## Background

The code-review and doc-review prompts carry a "User decisions" section: `decision` items (`D-NN`) under an issue's `## Decisions` heading bind the review, a blocking finding whose only remedy a decision forecloses is not raised, and a contradicted factual premise is an advisory finding citing the decision's address. The holistic-review prompt has no such section, so a container review re-raised a finding the user had accepted in a recorded decision. The plan-review and breakdown-review prompts bind only decisions the plan or manifest cites, which does not cover a user decision recorded on the container itself. Nothing checks that the prompts carry the section, so it can drift out of any of them unnoticed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The holistic-review, plan-review and breakdown-review prompts carry the "User decisions" section worded identically to the code-review prompt's.
- [hard] REQ-02: The repository's mechanical documentation checks fail when any of the five review prompts (code, doc, holistic, plan, breakdown) lacks that section's binding sentence or carries it more than once.

## Notes

- The prompts are repository-local gate configuration, drawn into the dogfood profile package as live assets.
title: Every review prompt binds user decisions
